Do you enjoy working with technology and building complex products? As an Assembly Technician, you will work on advanced electromechanical systems within an innovative high-tech production environment. You will join an international organization where technology, quality, and collaboration are at the heart of everything. Together with your colleagues, you will assemble modules and systems that are used worldwide in advanced technological applications. What’s your job about? A proactive and hands-on attitude. Sense of responsibility and ownership. Good communication skills in English. What do you get in return? A position within an innovative high-tech organization. A gross monthly salary between €3.300 and €3.600, including shift allowance. Extensive training and development opportunities. Careegrowth possibilities within production, technology, or engineering. A modern and professional working environment. An international and collaborative team culture. Competitive employment conditions. You will join a leading high-tech manufacturing organization in the Eindhoven region. The company develops and produces advanced technological systems and modules that are used worldwide in industries such as semiconductors, healthcare, industrial automation, and mobility. Innovation, quality, and continuous improvement are central to the organization. Employees are encouraged to take initiative, develop their technical skills, and build a long-term career within a dynamic international environment.
